description: Set B' (§ 8.1; n = 1, w = 2 as A', n_R = n) sweeping protein decay delta_p, which now sets both reversion and the ceiling: p_inf = 8 / delta_p and t_rev = ln(p_inf / p*) / min(delta_m, delta_p) (eq. 30).
